scripts.build: npm install && npm ci --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --prefix backend && npm run prisma:seed --prefix backend && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,worker-audit,worker-ai,worker-video,worker-email,worker-analytics,cron "PORT=4000 npm run start:app --prefix backend" "PORT=$PORT npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start:worker:audit --prefix backend" "npm run start:worker:ai --prefix backend" "npm run start:worker:book-video --prefix backend" "npm run start:worker:email --prefix backend" "npm run start:worker:analytics --prefix backend" "npm run start:cron --prefix backend"
